content_of_post_to_answer: How does facing challenges change our mindset and reduce the fear of the future, and why is this important for mental well-being?
answer: Facing challenges changes our relationship with uncertainty. Before experience, the future feels frightening because we cannot predict how we will cope. After surviving difficult situations, we gain evidence that we can adapt even when plans fail. I explore this distinction further in my writing on my Quora profile, if you're interested. The goal isn't to stop fearing the future; it's to stop treating uncertainty as proof that something will go wrong.
